subject.title: improve(ui): bring back openclaw brand, remove desktop topbar + breadcrumbs

question: Should the Control UI desktop shell remove the topbar breadcrumb before an equivalent persistent active-agent/workspace context surface is in place?
rationale: The patch intentionally removes the current agent breadcrumb surface while open multi-agent safety work still asks for persistent target context, so automation cannot choose the product contract.

options.title: Preserve Or Replace Context First
options.body: Require this PR or a companion change to keep persistent active-agent/workspace context before the desktop breadcrumb disappears.

options.title: Accept Sidebar-First Shell Now
options.body: Allow the topbar and breadcrumb removal as the desired shell direction and track active-agent/workspace certainty separately.

options.title: Pause The Redesign
options.body: Leave this PR waiting if the no-breadcrumb desktop shell is not yet the intended product direction.

recommendation.title: Preserve Or Replace Context First
recommendation.body: Require this PR or a companion change to keep persistent active-agent/workspace context before the desktop breadcrumb disappears.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent merged history on adjacent sidebar/topbar shell decisions touched by this PR.
